SELECT 'dates' k, CAST(min(calendar_date) AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(max(calendar_date) AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) c FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_quarter=4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales rows', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns rows', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR), '' FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'regions', region, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store GROUP BY region
UNION ALL
SELECT 'south stores current', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), store_name, CAST(is_current AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND region='South'

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.cost) AS cost, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),1) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d  ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 'cur per sku >1' k, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) v FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'cur per store >1', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'South sales stores in Q4 by as-was region', s.region || ' / ' || cs.region || ' n=' || CAST(count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 AND (s.region='South' OR cs.region='South') GROUP BY s.region, cs.region

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.store_id, cs.region, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) AS diff
FROM ctl c LEFT JOIN mine m USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=c.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE cs.region='South' OR abs(m.mine-c.ctl)>1 ORDER BY 1
